title: VDE VM Type Configuration
description: Schema for VDE VM type static configuration. The Beskar Vault — sole authority for VM type data.

vms.description: Flat list of all VM type definitions

kind.description: Whether this is a language VM (ssh_port 2200-2399) or service VM (ssh_port 2400-2499)

name.description: Canonical VM identifier used for container naming and SSH config

aliases.description: Alternative names accepted by the CLI

display.description: Human-readable name for UI and logging

pkgs.description: System packages to install at image build time

setup_script.description: Path to the hydration script, relative to the project root

service_ports.description: Ports exposed by this service VM; empty for language VMs

ssh_port.description: SSH port on the Docker host
